_comment: Synthetic claims for Example Mutual. Claim numbers per docs/phase3/DATA-CONTRACTS.md (CLM-YYMM-NNNNN-C, Luhn mod-10, machine-verified when generated -- CLM-2608-00042-4 is the same worked example used in DATA-CONTRACTS.md and endorsements.md). All settlement arithmetic follows data/synthetic/policy/coverage-logic.md's formulas exactly -- every deductible_applied_cad and settlement_amount_cad below was computed from that spec, not chosen independently, so a Phase 5 implementation can be checked against these as fixtures. Loss locations are generic Ontario descriptions, not real addresses. Status values: Reported | UnderReview | RepairInProgress | Settled | Closed -- covers the range CheckClaimStatus should be evaluated against. No K/A-fatal-tier claims are included as live intake scenarios -- L1's hard-escalation fixtures belong to Phase 6/7's eval and red-team suites (docs/phase2/THREAT-MODEL.md), not this baseline data corpus; KABCO A (suspected serious, non-fatal) appears once (claim 8) purely as a historical-record severity field, not a live-conversation trigger.

claims.description: Rear-ended another vehicle while merging; insured found mostly at fault. Flagship demo claim for the rental/towing compound RAG+tool case -- matches endorsements.md's worked example exactly (12 days used, 8 remaining).

Other driver ran a stop sign; insured not at fault, no police report filed (no injury, minor damage). No Loss-or-Damage coverage on this policy -- DCPD is the only coverage that responds, no deductible. Demonstrates the deductible-free DCPD path plus the bundled towing allowance.

Lost control on black ice, single-vehicle, ran into a ditch -- 100% at fault, no other party. 16,000/18,000 = 88.9% >= Example Mutual's stated 80%-of-ACV total-loss threshold. Settlement = ACV - deductible = 18,000 - 1,000 = 17,000, matching coverage-logic.md §2's worked example exactly. Rental endorsement not payable here -- total-loss settlement, not repair, per endorsements.md's own terms ('does not apply if your automobile is settled as a total loss'), so days_used stays at 0 despite the endorsement being elected on the policy.

claims.loss_location: Fairview Mall parking lot, Kitchener, ON
claims.description: Backed into a concrete parking bollard; single-vehicle, 100% at fault. Freshly reported, still under review -- pairs with the same policyholder's fresh-claim / early-status-check scenarios.

Vehicle stolen overnight, recovered three days later with damage. Not a fault-based claim -- theft is a Comprehensive peril, DCPD/fault apportionment doesn't apply. Fully closed, older claim -- exercises the 'Closed' status value.
Windows broken and paint keyed while parked overnight. Settled, no rental (not elected on this policy).

claims.loss_location: Hurontario St at Eglinton Ave, Mississauga, ON
claims.description: Rear-ended at a red light, not at fault, vehicle undriveable and towed. Claim #1 of the year for this policy -- oldest claim in the corpus (matches the low end of the claim-number sequence). Same policyholder and vehicle as CLM-2608-00042-4, an older and fully closed claim -- gives one policyholder two claims at different lifecycle stages for CheckClaimStatus variety.

claims.loss_location: Dundas St at Confederation Pkwy, Mississauga, ON
claims.accident_benefits_track_informational: Assessment pending -- likely non-catastrophic track per coverage-logic.md §3's informational framing; not yet determined, and never determined by this system regardless of outcome
claims.description: Rear-ended at a stoplight, not at fault, whiplash with radiating pain reported -- suspected serious injury (KABCO A), clinical assessment pending. Property portion (DCPD, no deductible) is straightforward; the Accident Benefits portion is the coverage-logic.md §4 test case -- this policyholder HAS elected Income Replacement Benefit, so 'am I entitled to income replacement on this claim' is answerable as yes (election-fact lookup), while 'how much, and when' is always deflected (eligibility/amount determination, pending medical assessment). This is a historical claim record field, not a live escalation trigger -- L1's hard-escalation fixtures live in Phase 6/7's eval suite, not here.
